mechanism.claim: A clockwise normalized loop between cumulative BTC return and cumulative premium-index change means derivatives premium moved before price along a completed same-direction displacement. During elevated BTC variation, an unusually large fresh clockwise phase loop identifies derivatives-led price discovery; follow the common completed direction for eight elapsed hours.
mechanism.side: common strict sign of completed premium-index displacement and BTC return
mechanism.why_distinct: HVPPLA compares one-minute cross-lag Spearman correlations; cash-basis feedback uses spot-to-basis lag correlation; premium occupation measures time above a baseline; HVSPH loops BTC cumulative return against cumulative realized variation. HVPPL instead uses the signed shoelace phase-loop area between normalized cumulative BTC return and premium change. It reuses no event set or control and uses no spot, volume, flow, funding values, OI, fitted outcome, or post-entry data.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed BTC variation must occupy its causal upper 35 percent and clockwise loop magnitude its causal upper quartile
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: 03:35/11:35/19:35 UTC phase-loop onsets are absent from Gross9 clocks

features.joined_block: 480 exact timestamp-aligned unique coherent BTCUSDT perpetual and premium-index one-minute rows [D-8h,D); positive BTC OHLC and finite coherent signed premium OHLC; no imputation
features.normalized_paths: x_0=y_0=0; x_k=cumsum(r_1..r_k)/sqrt(sum r_i^2); y_k=cumsum(dp_1..dp_k)/sqrt(sum dp_i^2); both denominators strict positive
features.phase_loop_area: A=0.5*sum from k=0..478 of (x_k*y_(k+1)-x_(k+1)*y_k); finite strict negative; negative orientation is preregistered clockwise premium-leading geometry
features.area_magnitude_rank: strict-prior midrank of abs(A) over at most 270 source-valid decisions, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.75
features.btc_displacement: sum r_i, finite strict nonzero and same sign as premium_displacement
features.onset: eligible now and immediately preceding scheduled source-valid decision ineligible; missing or invalid prior cannot trigger

clock.reservation: global chronological half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi: not signal inputs; exact funding only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval and final

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent cross-state phase-orientation mechanism selected from formula-absence and complete-source audit only

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no source, path normalization, area formula, orientation, alignment, history, rank, threshold, variation, confirmation, onset, direction, clock, hold, subset, or control repair
